items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: Harry mostly played the clarinet with me all the time... it was Brown Lee's brother-in-law that played the banjo. [INTERVIEWER] ...it was French, Barrowman French.

ctx.x: Did he play with you much in those days? Yes. Yes. Mostly. Harry mostly played the clarinet with me all the time. There was Harry Shields, Brown Lee, Joe Lloyd Canner, myself, and I can't think of his name, but it was Brown Lee's brother-in-law that played the banjo.
Oh I have a note on the record, it was French, Barrowman French. That's his name, yeah.
And Crum, Crum, Crum, Crum, Crum, Crum, Crum, Crum, Crum, I think it was something like that. I just can't remember.
